mentions.name: HailPass
mentions.description: This service sells a season pass for latlong/street-address-level targeted hail notifications, built specifically for damaging-size hail (not just any hail) on the Colorado front range. Email alerts are free and text alerts are on the season pass model.
mentions.problem: Generic hail notifications are not targeted to damaging-size hail at a precise latlong/street-address level.
mentions.source_excerpt: Already up and running: https://hailpass.com/?ref=HAILHN9 (ref code there knocks $10 off the season price) as a "season pass" for latlong/street address level-targeted hail notifications, built specifically for damaging-size hail (not just _any_ hail) on the Colorado front range. Email is free, texts are on the season pass model.
